title: Databases without active sessions
description: Return exactly one column, database_name, for every database with no active sessions. Idle sessions do not count as active. Sort by database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT d.name AS database_name
FROM databases AS d
hints: LEFT JOIN must preserve the database when no matching active session exists.
Put state = active in ON, then test for NULL on the sessions side.
solution_explanation: Putting the state filter in ON avoids turning LEFT JOIN into INNER JOIN and preserves databases without active sessions.
